bias.en: Neutral, weakening · back under the 5-day, testing $145
bias.zh: 中性偏弱 · 跌回 5 日均线下方，测试 $145

read.en: SpaceX fell 2.3% on Oct 28 to $145.23, trading between $142.13 and $147.57, with no 100-day yet (96 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($146.6), 10-day ($148.3) and 30-day ($153.3) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14, now below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($165.07), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月28日下跌 2.3%，收于 $145.23，盘中区间 $142.13–147.57；上市仅 96 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$146.6）、10 日（$148.3）和 30 日均线（$153.3）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，现已跌破零轴，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$165.07），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The close lost the $146.6 Oct 27 low, now resistance; an intraday dip to $142.1 recovered to hold the $145 area. Resistance is $146.6–147.6 (5-day, Oct 28 high), then $148.3–150 (10-day, $150 cap) and $153.3–154.3 (30-day, Oct 22 high). Support is $144.1–144.6 (Oct 23 and Oct 26 lows), then $142.1 (Oct 28 low) and $140.7 (Oct 15 low). A close above $147.6 would target $150; below $144, $142.

r.en: Oct 27 low $146.6, lost; 5-day average $146.6; Oct 28 high $147.6
